primitives.what: The style's hero shape: radial gradient, inner shadow (bottom-right), 0.7 px white hairline. Circle or rounded square.
Full-frame radial grey (#4d4f56 → #121317), sent to the back. Only added when a scene makes its own comp.
Scale in 0 → 115 → 95 → 100 % by 0.54 s, eased, with a 0.12 s fade.
Rise 120 px (at 1080p) into place on expo out (out influence 0 / in influence 100) over 1 s, with a 0.12 s fade.
Many entrances in rhythm: in-order, reverse or center-out, 0.08 s apart, or fitted into a total time. Works on any layers and any entrance.
primitives.call: stagger(layers, {enter: slideUp, at, total: 1.5, duration: 1.0, order})

scenes.what: Orb and rounded square, popping in (side by side; stacked in portrait).
Five orbs rippling in from the centre with pop.
Five orbs rising in left to right with slideUp, all landed by 1.5 s.
